listing.status: Active - Price Change (cut to $1,250,000 on 2026-10-22, 2nd reduction from $1,395,000; back on market 2026-09-28 after fallen escrow)
listing.description: Experience spectacular, unobstructed panoramic views from this completely renovated contemporary home nestled in the coveted Montclair Hills. Enjoy breathtaking vistas of the San Francisco skyline, Bay Bridge, Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, Oakland skyline, Port of Oakland, and the sparkling waters of San Francisco Bay from the expansive wraparound deck, perfectly positioned to showcase the home's extraordinary setting. This beautifully remodeled 3-bedroom, 3-bath home offers approximately 1,551± sq. ft. of thoughtfully designed living space featuring brand new wide-plank luxury vinyl flooring throughout, a stunning chef's kitchen with all-new cabinetry, countertops, stainless steel appliances and designer finishes, plus three fully renovated bathrooms showcasing today's most desirable style. The newly rebuilt wraparound deck with sleek glass railings creates the ultimate indoor-outdoor living experience while preserving the incredible views. A beautifully tiled front patio offers a peaceful, private retreat surrounded by mature landscaping. Additional upgrades include a brand new water heater, detached two-car garage, and two additional driveway parking spaces. Located just minutes from Montclair Village, regional parks, hiking trails, Highway 13 and major commuter routes, this move-in ready home delivers a truly exceptional combination of luxury, location, and some of the most breathtaking unobstructed panoramic views the Oakland Hills has to offer—an opportunity rarely found at this price point.

condition.note: Turnkey 2026 flip: new floors/kitchen/3 baths/deck/water heater (p_17/24/29/06), staged well. Tells: popcorn texture left in bath (p_29), ~5-month reno after a $655K purchase, flat membrane roofs of unknown age with skylights (p_38).

lot_usability.note: 0.43 AC on paper, but the top-down drone (p_42/44) shows usable land is just the house pad, patio and driveway; everything else is steep dry slope — no level yard, high maintenance acres.

verdict: This house IS the trade: a turnkey 1961 view-box bought by a flipper for $655K in Feb 2026 and flipped after a ~5-month cosmetic renovation — you pay ~$831/sf for a genuinely spectacular, verified bay panorama and zero day-one projects, while inheriting the full Oakland-hills risk stack: Very High FHSZ insurance, flat roofs with skylights, a tall downslope foundation wall, and a steep, mostly unusable 0.43-acre lot. The withdrawn $1.395M listing, one fallen escrow, and 48 DOM say pricing power sits with the buyer. It fits a view-first buyer who can clear an insurance quote and roof/foundation inspections before removing contingencies — and it should be priced against 6401 Snake (4.2 @ $998K), not against the ask.
flags: 🔥 Very High FHSZ (94611 Montclair, inside the 1991 Oakland firestorm footprint): dense eucalyptus and conifers within feet of the structure on all sides (p_07/38/42/45) — get insurance quotes incl. CA FAIR Plan BEFORE removing contingencies; expect ongoing defensible-space work.

💰 Flip arithmetic: bought $655,000 on 2026-02-16, relisted $1,395,000 on 2026-07-14, withdrawn 2026-08-14, relisted $1,289,000 on 2026-09-01, one contingent deal fell through 2026-09-28 — demand permits/finals for the ~5-month renovation; history says negotiate.
⚪ Flat membrane roofs over BOTH house and garage with skylights (p_01/38/40) — age and warranty unknown; roof certification + drainage inspection essential; classic winter-leak typology.

🏗️ Downslope construction: view side sits on a 12-15 ft stucco cripple/foundation wall with cantilevered deck over the slope (p_34/47) — geotech/seismic and deck-ledger inspections; verify any post-fire-rebuild or retrofit status.
🌳 Fuel load: eucalyptus sea below the deck (p_11), redwood/pine touching walls (p_07/45), dry grass + wood-chip slopes (p_25/39/42) — defensible space will be a recurring cost, not a one-time fix.
👀 Privacy weak spots: bed-3 window ~10-15 ft from the neighbor's wall (p_26); upslope neighbor's deck overlooks the front patio (p_44); the view deck overlooks downslope neighbor roofs (p_07/35).
🛣️ Overhead utility lines along Skyline and Hwy 13/24 light trails inside the view cone at dusk (p_37) — possible freeway hum; visit at commute hours.
🧱 Fast-flip tells: popcorn texture left in a bath (p_29), staging-grade fixtures, windowless tiled annex (p_28) — inspect behind the finishes (panel, sewer lateral, hillside drainage).
🪟 Jalousie windows: none observed — new sliders/single-hung units throughout; sensitivity clear.
